note: Reel 47. r01-r02: the robber (whispered later, over the whole line, by whisper.py); r02 says 'shtraight' (s-retraction, /ʃtɹ/). u01: the line-up's line for the four other men. n01-n21: the narrator, af_heart. The cast auditions American men's voices for the robber and the four others, each reading r01, r02 and u01.
ref_text: The station was quiet by the time we got there. Somebody had left a radio on in the back, and nobody wanted to be the one to switch it off.

lines.text: That's the man robbing you, so remember his voice.
Which of these five is him? Whoever you pick is charged tonight.
I told you to remember his voice.
He never let you hear it.
He whispered, and a whisper has no pitch, because your vocal cords don't vibrate.
But one thing came through. Listen.
An S never uses your vocal cords, so a whisper barely changes it.
lines.text_kokoro: An [S](/ˈɛs/) never uses your vocal cords, so a whisper barely changes it.

lines.text: If you picked four, you caught him by one sound.
If you didn't, he walks, and the man you picked goes to jail for a voice nobody heard.
Now try it on the friend who never forgets a voice.
Which of these five is him?
Whoever you pick is charged tonight.
